phases.objective: Make Repository Inventory regeneration a bounded recipe of the existing governed generated-artifact writer while keeping pull-request verification read-only and resolving the writer's first-install self-hosting cycle without executing candidate mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository inventory verifier, trusted dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request on a governed work branch has stale Repository Inventory outputs, either under already-trusted Inventory authority or while installing that authority for the first time.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ordinary stale-only pull requests are delegated to the already-trusted writer. A first-install authority pull request remains read-only, proves deterministic exact-head candidate outputs with the canonical generator unchanged from main, reports bootstrap_pending instead of executing candidate write authority, and requires the generated-output follow-up to run only after the writer has become trusted on main.
steps: Run Repository Inventory on the exact pull-request head with contents read only and no persisted checkout credentials.
Regenerate the three Inventory outputs and run the canonical Inventory check and self-test.
For an ordinary stale-only PR, require same-repository identity, main base, zero-behind freshness, unchanged trusted authority, deterministic output, and exact three-file drift before delegation.
For a self-hosting authority installation, require the PR to remain same-repository, main-based, non-protected, exact-head, and zero-behind.
Require scripts/repository-inventory.mjs, package.json, and package-lock.json to be byte-unchanged from trusted main before bootstrap_pending is allowed.

Require the authority installation to include the governed writer workflow, Inventory verifier, Inventory autofix dispatcher, and generated-artifact maintenance tool, plus the repository-inventory-governed-regeneration E2E contract.
Require deterministic regeneration to dirty exactly docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, and docs/repository-inventory.md and no other worktree path.
Publish bootstrap_pending as read-only evidence; do not commit, push, dispatch candidate write code, mutate a protected branch, or force-push.

After source authority merges to main, create a non-protected generated-output work branch from that trusted main, invoke repository_inventory_refresh through the trusted writer, and verify the resulting exact head before the generated-output PR is merged.
assertions: Repository Inventory pull-request verification has contents read only and performs no git push.
Repository Inventory regeneration writes exactly docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, and docs/repository-inventory.md.
The self-hosting bootstrap may report bootstrap_pending only on pull_request, never on push or workflow_dispatch.
bootstrap_pending requires the canonical Inventory generator and package contract to be unchanged from trusted main.
bootstrap_pending requires behind_by zero and an exact three-output dirty set with no additional worktree changes.
bootstrap_pending is evidence only: repository_mutation, protected_branch_mutation, and force_push remain false.
Candidate-modified generated-artifact mutation authority is never executed before it is trusted on main.
The ordinary automatic dispatcher still refuses candidate-modified mutation authority and requires its trusted control surface to match main.
The dispatcher has actions write only in the delegation job and never receives contents write permission.
The governed writer requires an exact expected_head_sha and typed confirmation, rejects main and Production, and never force-pushes.
The post-merge bootstrap uses a non-protected work branch; main and Production remain outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets.
Generated-artifact verification routes repository_inventory_refresh to Repository Inventory rather than a generic verifier.
Production deployment, database mutation, direct protected-ref mutation, and secret publication are outside this feature.

phases.objective: Observe the first trusted post-merge Repository Inventory generated-output follow-up on a non-protected work branch and retain canonical exact-head verification evidence.

Exercise stale SHA, main drift, changed generator/package contract, changed authority surface, nondeterministic generation, dirty-set escape, no-op, dispatch failure, and post-push readback mismatch paths.
Use the first post-merge generated-output work branch as the bounded canary for repository_inventory_refresh.
Keep main and Production outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets while allowing trusted merged authority to govern ordinary work branches.
